decisions.reason: This premium hand-knotted carpet is niche but differentiated and consistent with the firm's design and materials positioning, so the option remains worth keeping despite a moderate risk of later withdrawal.

After another year the remaining uncertainty around this close-to-core low-pile carpet is lower, and given earlier pruning of similar carpet launches management would likely reallocate resources if it has not clearly stood out by now.
The corner bench serves a more specific use case, but it still builds on established furnishing capabilities and can continue to be tested in project business for another year.
The swivel shell chair line fits the firm's direction toward flexible workplace concepts and, as a multi-model seating family, still looks like an option worth maintaining.
